nonGoals: no executor.kind flip to llm (llm executor returns text only; code work goes through autopilot->opencode drive)
no changes to planfile repo sync internals

architecture.decision: defer_sync_on_create() reentrant context in planfile_sync.py gates sync_after_ticket_create; apply_scan_suggestions wraps the create loop and calls sync_planfile_integrations once when tickets were applied; planfile-CLI create drops --sync

validation.evidence: deferred create does not sync per ticket; one batch sync runs after apply loop
